cs.t: I have a Dasung Paperlike that I use and it's been pretty great for my eye strain. For most developer workflows it's good enough. Latency has never been a problem for coding, I think its around 10-16 fps. There's some residual ink that gets left on screen, but I don't notice it at all anymore. Obviously you can't do any color work or watch a video, but other than that I almost never have to switch to my regular screen. The only annoying part are all the cables that have to be set up to work (it requires both a USB and a displayport simultaneously).
